external_components.name: DISABLE_GPIO
external_components.kind: external 3.3V GPIO, default assert until anchor stable plus20us, not POR

note: Transistor test module only; no pads/ESD, precision voltage anchor or external R/C implementation. Use extracted junction geometry.
design_changes: Selected12MOS VI with explicit DISABLE clamp and conditional keeper return; original11MOS unchanged.
Actual M5 VIN/VSS/IOUT trunks and M2 terminal feeds. W1 keeper uses one via1 terminal cut and three trunk vias; small D/S pitch uses .8um leg and displaced stack.
External OUT-to-KRET1.8M keeper only conducts during external DISABLE assertion; no autonomous POR.
electrical_physical_independence: Physical D/G/S/B independently authored in JSON; gold independently parsed from electrical MOS source. No netlist-to-placement parser.

power_routing.kind: additional actual copper and via arrays
